70c12d43f8c8e55142aa43c1d7f3acd914dfe105.text: 这次故障反而促成升级，算是因祸得福。

70c4ea57d6ce7d9cd1e7b16ee4fdd1e5aba0be52.pinyin: xiǎo gǒu yǎo zhù le wǒ de xié dài.

70c864c0a4d3f6b1dfb1c810066f597fbb232ae5.pinyin: Zǎo chén liù diǎn, jiē shàng de diàn pù hái méi yǒu kāi mén.
70c864c0a4d3f6b1dfb1c810066f597fbb232ae5.text: 早晨六点，街上的店铺还没有开门。

70c99ebf1632a347aeef9ee7d6bd0730def4d0af.pinyin: mén tà guān bì yǐ hòu, shǒu wèi liú zài wài miàn.
70c99ebf1632a347aeef9ee7d6bd0730def4d0af.text: 门闼关闭以后，守卫留在外面。

70cae23f2154350463b0650f7b7b7456f2a54827.pinyin: shǐ shū xiě chén zǐ yì dài xīn jūn.

70cd04e2f1d6afe091614763bf375d7db5f1f4b7.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi zūn shǒu jiāo tōng guī zé.

70cf39ab00b9db8688f9834b987a81ca843a01ee.pinyin: chéng běn shàng zhǎng huì jiǎn shǎo lì rùn.

70cfac7b1bc3bc8d7fea39a6ddc6476989f9bba1.pinyin: fēi zhōu shì zhuǎn yí de dà zhōu.

70d043b61c7e13caa48b0003769e64870cdc82ba.pinyin: liǎng tái shè bèi xū yào tóng bù shí jiān.
70d043b61c7e13caa48b0003769e64870cdc82ba.text: 两台设备需要同步时间。

70d2532647d13fea8b4fb65daea04cda6259be3c.pinyin: tā shòu cuò zhī hòu dǒng de chéng bì.

70d7a750d822253a5ac58ccab6406ff71f517258.pinyin: zhè ge bǔ ding xiū fù le cuò wù.

70d7aa053326a82e698d54f243746462053c9507.pinyin: tā bǎ zhuō shàng de zá wù shōu qǐ lai.
70d7aa053326a82e698d54f243746462053c9507.text: 他把桌上的杂物收起来。

70dbf4525fd52bad0ced48618dce9c964b3fbb8f.pinyin: qiǎn shuǐ tián shì yí zhòng zhí cí gū.

70dea34c803d2cb15801d8ed0f137567acebc284.pinyin: zhè ge tuán duì de chéng yuán liáng yǒu bù qí.
70dea34c803d2cb15801d8ed0f137567acebc284.text: 这个团队的成员良莠不齐。

70e36118ab7e12a226f61676ed9364da727ccdcf.pinyin: hé shuǐ fàn làn, àn biān de fān chuán piāo le chū qù.
70e36118ab7e12a226f61676ed9364da727ccdcf.text: 河水泛滥，岸边的帆船漂了出去。

70e9bf2dd58d8837f40a4e056872f4dbb048e81c.pinyin: hú miàn shàng tū rán guā qǐ biāo fēng.

70ed508ee5715d71e5f269a95cdf095fca456212.pinyin: nǐ bù bì dā jì chéng chē.

70efbd12d6d24d70c7e3808553ee3a55f3806dde.pinyin: zhè wèi jiào yuán fù zé zhǐ dǎo shí jì cāo zuò.
70efbd12d6d24d70c7e3808553ee3a55f3806dde.text: 这位教员负责指导实际操作。

70eff48f36e56700b878ef21972311f1d2f2d905.pinyin: wǒ men cóng ā gēn tíng jìn kǒu le ròu lèi.
70eff48f36e56700b878ef21972311f1d2f2d905.text: 我们从阿根廷进口了肉类。

70f001d9572e53d4bb24c58917bfadc7ba9cc38c.pinyin: bào gào liè chū le nóng yè chǎn zhí.

70f2a9c8e06699b4ac3c40a3a3b406e070907752.pinyin: zhè jiàn yī fu bǐ nà jiàn pián yi.

70f5d56141b7d14475f45baecacc6113c5e04fd1.pinyin: zhǎo dào shī wù de xī wàng hěn miǎo máng.
70f5d56141b7d14475f45baecacc6113c5e04fd1.text: 找到失物的希望很渺茫。

70f9f002086c959f7f363d225f071a4dd9348278.pinyin: tīng dào hǎo xiāo xi, tā fǔ zhǎng chēng kuài.
70f9f002086c959f7f363d225f071a4dd9348278.text: 听到好消息，他拊掌称快。
